reviews.title: Falls short in the most basic way
reviews.text: Overall, HiHello is a good digital business card app, but it has one significant limitation: the inability to capture both sides of a business card. This shortcoming has proven counterproductive and has forced me to rely on a separate app to perform this task. The back of a business card often contains valuable information, such as QR codes, company logos, additional contact details, and other important data. Since HiHello cannot capture this information, it is either lost or must be entered manually, wasting time and overall efficiency. HiHello should prioritize adding a feature that allows users to scan, capture, and process both the front and back of a business card. This is an essential capability for a comprehensive digital business card and contact management app, not merely a convenience. Without it, users are forced to rely on competing applications to complete a basic task that should be seamlessly integrated into the app.
